rules.title: Waiting period
rules.text: A SGD 5.00 no-show fee may apply after at least five minutes at the designated pickup point and a reasonable contact attempt.

rules.title: Pickup ambiguity
rules.text: The selected pickup bay takes priority unless both parties agree to another safe location. Conflicting booking notes should be clarified; an app arrival event alone does not prove correct positioning.

rules.title: Contact and safety
rules.text: Consider timely rider replies and a reasonable opportunity to meet. Drivers need not remain where stopping is unsafe, but the safety claim and relocation communication should be assessed.

rules.title: Fee reversal
rules.text: Reverse the no-show fee when eligibility is not supported. Missing location data or a rider's reply alone does not conclusively establish either side's fault.

rules.title: Evidence uncertainty
rules.text: Account history is context only. Missing telemetry and GPS accuracy must be considered explicitly, without inferring fraud.
